# Generate Notion-style pages

---

**Prepare clear content, then render and check the page.**

- Read `notion-page --help` for the installed CLI's options.

- Apply the included guides within the scope stated in their descriptions. Apply concise, self-contained note rules throughout; apply procedural formatting to instructions and Turkish writing rules to Turkish content.

- Follow the page conversion instructions below. Use `notion-page --skill NAME` when a section refers to an additional CLI guide.

- Check that the content makes sense without the conversation before generating HTML. Check the rendered page in a browser before sharing it.
